theorem: For shells exp(k+c)<=p<exp(k+1+c), matching their reciprocal-prime mass to gamma covariance 1/(k+1/4) through second order uniquely forces c=-1/4.
determinant_class: At c=-1/4 the relative covariance ratio differs from identity by an l1 sequence, so the shell-radial comparison is trace class; unshifted shells are only Hilbert-Schmidt relative to gamma.
correspondence: Weighted shell incidence maps each oscillator mode isometrically to the normalized radial combination of all prime rays in that shell.
residual_sector: The orthogonal within-shell prime fluctuations must remain to carry exact individual phases and the linear Euler cross functional.
open_target: Decompose the Euler cross functional into radial and fluctuation parts and prove determinant-class control of the latter coupling.
status: quarter-shifted trace-class radial correspondence constructed asymptotically; full Euler block open
